# Seller Revenue by State
```{r state_revenue}
state_revenue <- readRDS("rds/state_revenue.rds")

sellers <- state_revenue|>
    mutate(
        state = if_else(seller_state_b == 'SP', 'SP', 'Other')
        ) 
        
a_sellers <- sellers |>
        summarise(
        total_sellers = sum(total_sellers),
        .by = state
    ) |>
    mutate(top_seller = 'All Sellers')

t_sellers <- sellers |>
    filter(top_seller == 'Top 20%') |>
    summarise(
        total_sellers = sum(total_sellers),
        .by = c(state, top_seller)
    )
sellers <- bind_rows(a_sellers, t_sellers)
sellers <- sellers |>
    mutate(
        share = total_sellers / sum(total_sellers),
        .by = top_seller
    ) 

saveRDS(sellers, "rds/seller_state.rds")
```

# Top Seller Reviews
```{r reviews}
seller_summary <- readRDS("rds/seller_summary.rds")

filter_seller_summary <- seller_summary |>
    mutate(top_seller = if_else(cum_sellers <= 0.2, 'Top 20%', 'Bottom 80%')) |> 
    filter(n_rvw >= 10) 
saveRDS(filter_seller_summary, "rds/seller_rvw.rds")

```

# Top Seller Shipping Delays
```{r freight}
seller_summary <- readRDS("rds/seller_summary.rds")

d_seller_summary <- seller_summary |> 
    filter(!is.na(delivery_days), n_deliveries >= 10) 

saveRDS(d_seller_summary, 'rds/seller_freight.rds')

```

```{r freight_pred}
d <- d_seller_summary |>
    mutate(
        round_delivery = round(delivery_days, 0),
        round_est = round(est_delivery_days, 0),
        est_status = case_when(
        round_est > round_delivery ~ 'Early',
        round_est == round_delivery ~ 'On Time',
        round_est < round_delivery ~ 'Late'
    ))
table(d$est_status)
glimpse(d)

```

# Median Items Sold
```{r med}
t <- seller_summary |>

    )

t_median <- t[1,2]
```

# Num Orders
```{r trim}
num_orders <- readRDS("rds/num_orders.rds")

num_orders <- num_orders |>

```

# Filtering Revenue
```{r filter}
revenue <- readRDS("rds/revenue.rds")
filtered_revenue <- revenue |>
    mutate(order_date = yearmonth(order_date)) |>
    filter(between(order_date, yearmonth('2017 January'), yearmonth('2018 August'))) 
f_revenue <- filtered_revenue|>
    mutate(order_date = as.Date(order_date))
saveRDS(f_revenue, 'rds/filtered_revenue.rds')
```    

# Validation
```{r new_model}
# Filtering out the Black Friday spikes
avg_nov <- filtered_revenue |>
    as_tibble() |>
    filter(order_date %in% c(yearmonth('2017 October'), yearmonth('2017 December'))) |>
    summarise(
        mean_revenue = mean(revenue),
        .by = top_seller
    )

avg_r <- filtered_revenue |>
    as_tibble() |>
    left_join(avg_nov, by = 'top_seller') |>
    mutate(revenue = if_else(order_date == yearmonth('2017 November'), mean_revenue, revenue)) |>
    select(-mean_revenue)

avg_r <- avg_r |>
    as_tsibble(index = order_date, key = top_seller) 

#Filter out last 3 months for testing
filtered_r <- avg_r |>
    filter(order_date <= yearmonth('2018 May'))

#Fit several models at once
fit <- filtered_r |>
    model(
        ets = ETS(revenue), #Exponential Smoothing
        arima = ARIMA(revenue), #Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average
        naive = NAIVE(revenue), #Naive- assumes no systemic change. Is a benchmark
        lm = TSLM(revenue ~ trend()) #Linear regression model
    )

#MAPE = Mean Absolute Percent Error
fit |> forecast(h = 3) |>
    accuracy(avg_r) |>
    arrange(top_seller, MAPE)

```

# Cross Validation
```{r cross_validate}
cv_data <- avg_r |> stretch_tsibble(.init = 12, .step = 1) |>
    filter(.id < max(.id)) |>
    filter(.id < max(.id)) |>
    filter(.id < max(.id)) 

fit_c <- cv_data |>
    model(
        ets = ETS(revenue), #Exponential Smoothing
        arima = ARIMA(revenue), #Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average
        naive = NAIVE(revenue), #Naive- assumes no systemic change. Is a benchmark
        lm = TSLM(revenue ~ trend()) #Linear regression model
    )

cross_validation <- fit_c |> forecast(h = 3) |>
    accuracy(avg_r) |>
    arrange(top_seller, MAPE)

cross_validation <- cross_validation |>
    select(.model, top_seller, MAPE) |>
    mutate(
        .model = case_match(
            .model,
            'ets' ~ 'ETS',
            'arima' ~ 'ARIMA',
            'naive' ~ 'Naive',
            'lm' ~ 'Linear Trend'
        )
    ) |>
    rename(Model = .model) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = top_seller, values_from = MAPE)

cross_validation
saveRDS(cross_validation, 'rds/cross_validation.rds')
#The final forecast goes 6 months out. We test 3 months out, and drop the last 3 rounds instead of the last one, since those rounds don't have 3 months of actual data to compare against. We don't have that many months (20), so going up to 6 months would leave very few rounds. Hence, we test 3 rounds.

```

# Forecast
```{r forecast_0}


last_top <- revenue |>
    filter(top_seller == 'Top 20%') |>
    slice_max(
        order_by = order_date,
        n = 1
    ) |>
    mutate(
        order_date = order_date, 
        top_seller = top_seller, 
        fit = revenue, 
        lwr = revenue, 
        upr = revenue, 
        .keep = 'none'
    )

last_bot <- revenue |>
    filter(top_seller == 'Bottom 80%') |>
    slice_max(
        order_by = order_date,
        n = 1
    ) |>
    mutate(
        order_date = order_date, 
        top_seller = top_seller, 
        fit = revenue, 
        lwr = revenue, 
        upr = revenue, 
        .keep = 'none'
    )
#Using 2 different models for the different groups
fit_final <- avg_r |>
    model(
        lm = TSLM(revenue ~ trend()), #Linear regression model
        naive = NAIVE(log(revenue))
    )

forecast <- fit_final |> 
    forecast(h = 6) |>
    filter(
        (.model == "naive" & top_seller == "Top 20%") | 
        (.model == "lm" & top_seller == "Bottom 80%")
        )
forecast
fc <- forecast |>
    mutate(median = median(revenue)) |>
    hilo(level = 80) |>
    unpack_hilo('80%') |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(fit = median, lwr = `80%_lower`, upr = `80%_upper`, order_date, top_seller) |>
    mutate(order_date = as.Date(order_date))

filtered_revenue <- filtered_revenue |>
    as.tibble() |>
    mutate(order_date = as.Date(yearmonth(order_date)))

last_rows <- filtered_revenue |>
    filter(order_date == max(order_date), .by = top_seller) |>
    mutate(
        order_date = order_date, 
        top_seller = top_seller, 
        fit = revenue, 
        lwr = revenue, 
        upr = revenue, 
        .keep = 'none'
    )

fc <- bind_rows(fc, last_rows)

saveRDS(fc, 'rds/forecast.rds')
```
